notes:
Inbound SMB lead; self-serve signup, used hosted API. Primary product: chat assistant for merchants combining product search + order support. Main pain: perceived slowness in chat UI after integrating our JS SDK. Customer is cost-conscious, wants to keep on public cloud (no VPC). Key ask: how to get sub-300ms p50 for short responses and reduce tail latency.

Observed from their traces:
- Default region set to eu-central-1 (latency spikes observed for NA users).
- Long prompts (400+ tokens) push p95 >2s. Short prompts (~30 tokens) still ~400-600ms depending on region.
- Frontend waits for full completion; they currently do not enable streaming.
- Their HTTP client has 30s socket timeout but frontend fetch/aborts after 3s causing partial errors.

SE notes / advice given on call (Priya):
- Recommend provisioning test keys in us-west-2 for NA traffic; expect ~150-250ms median improvement vs eu region due to network RTT.
- Enable streaming=true in SDK to display incremental tokens — improves perceived latency dramatically for messages >50 tokens.
- Reduce prompt preamble: move static system/context to server-side cache and use prefix-caching to avoid sending full product catalog context each call.
- Set client-side fetch timeout to 12s and backend socket timeout to 60s for longer completions; but for chat UI, stream + chunk render so you rarely need full timeout.
- Cap max_tokens per completion and move post-processing (reranking) to async pipeline if heavy.
- Suggest model variant with smaller footprint for short-turn chat (e.g., redwood-compact-1 or equivalent) for consistent p50 and cost savings.
- Add exponential backoff retry for 429s, and jitter to avoid synchronized retries.

Customer quote: "We see the UI hang for several seconds — even for simple questions — and users think the chat is dead."

Current actionables: AE to send perf checklist; SE to provision test keys + lightweight demo in us-west-2; customer to run synthetic tests using provided prompt set and share HAR traces.
